categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of power supply units, including switching power supplies, DC/DC converters, and motor controllers for compressors and fans. It also engages in the assembly of display products and outdoor portable power supplies, targeting niche and energy-saving markets such as signage displays, automotive fuel cells, and camping vehicle power distribution. Additionally, the company is expanding into industrial and commercial electronic products, including motor drive technologies and variable frequency compressors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include switching power supply design, DC to DC conversion, brushless DC motor control, and electronic control units for compressors and fans. The company employs firmware-based high-voltage, high-power driver designs to reduce component size and improve efficiency, integrating motor and driver controls into compact units. Production emphasizes lean manufacturing, process integration, quality management systems (TQM), and MES for traceability, with a focus on cost reduction and supplier diversification.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in the TV and commercial display sectors, industrial equipment manufacturers, and emerging markets such as hydrogen fuel cells and electric vehicles. The company serves industries including data centers, medical purification, energy storage, transportation (high-speed trains, ships), and outdoor advertising. It also targets niche markets like gaming machine displays and public kiosk touchscreens, focusing on customers requiring customized and energy-efficient power solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s sales are distributed across domestic Taiwan (approximately 33%), Asia (51%), Europe (8%), and the Americas (8%). It operates manufacturing and investment subsidiaries in Taiwan, Singapore, and Suzhou, China, with a global customer base primarily in Asia and expanding in Western markets. The company maintains supply chain and production facilities in these key regions to support its international sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain, manufacturing power supply units and electronic control products. It sources key components such as semiconductors, transformers, capacitors, and wiring from multiple suppliers to mitigate supply risks. It also provides ODM services and EMS manufacturing, including assembly and testing, positioning itself as a key component and module supplier to downstream electronics and industrial product manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include transitioning from traditional TV power supplies to niche and energy-saving products, expanding into industrial and automotive applications such as fuel cell power converters and motor controllers. R&D focuses on high-power DC/DC converters, EC fan and pump controllers, and display technologies integrating sensing and dynamic dimming for energy efficiency. The company emphasizes sustainability, supply chain resilience, digital transformation, and collaboration with customers and suppliers to develop high-value, customized solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of power supply units, motor controllers, and assembled display products. The company also earns income from EMS manufacturing services and long-term supply contracts with key customers. It focuses on increasing value-added product lines and expanding into new markets to stabilize and grow revenue streams amid declining traditional TV power supply demand.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a mature but evolving power supply market, facing competition from low-cost Chinese manufacturers and global suppliers. It differentiates itself through high automation, customization flexibility, stable quality, and competitive pricing. Its experience with international EMS clients and IATF16949 automotive quality certification strengthens its position in automotive and industrial sectors. The company aims to leverage technology alliances and product diversification to enhance competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported annual revenues of approximately NT$403 million in the latest fiscal year, down 31.5% from the prior year due to reduced orders and profitability in the TV power supply segment. Despite ongoing losses, net loss improved by 25.5%. R&D investment remains significant at around NT$24 million annually, with plans to increase. The company maintains stable asset and equity levels, with a focus on cost control and operational efficiency to return to profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high automation, customization, and stable quality as key value propositions, serving as a preferred partner for branded channel customers. Its deep EMS experience and automotive-grade quality certifications provide assurance of reliability and manufacturing excellence. Technological innovations in energy-efficient power supplies, integrated motor controls, and specialized display products offer customers differentiated, high-value solutions tailored to niche and emerging markets.
